svg.aria-label: Bipartite Slopegraph comparing Long Prose Generation vs Polyglot Coding Throughput across 28 GitHub Copilot models
svg.text: Bipartite Regime Transition · Rank & Throughput Slopegraph
When Prose Sprinters Meet Polyglot Code: How Model Rankings Reshuffle
Left axis ranks models on ~500-word unconstrained prose; right axis ranks mean throughput across 6 programming languages (Python, JS, Go, Java, C++, Rust).
Code Accelerators (Higher tok/s or +6 Rank Surge in Code)
Prose-to-Code Decelerators (>15 tok/s Drop or C++ Terse Penalty)
Note: claude-opus-5 jumps +16 ranks (#20 → #4) because its 1,634-token average code output amortizes the 8.0s first-token floor; mai-code-1.1-flash and gpt-5.6-luna drop as output length contracts.
